description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseConstraint' for representing constraints in Spark SQL's data catalog, including methods for generating DDL statements and descriptions, and an inner builder class for constructing constraint instances.

classes.name: BaseConstraint
classes.description: An abstract class representing a database constraint with properties like name, enforcement status, validation status, and reliance, including methods for generating DDL and descriptions.

classes.name: BaseConstraint.Builder
classes.description: An abstract static inner class implementing the builder pattern for constructing 'BaseConstraint' instances, with configurable properties such as enforcement, validation status, and reliance.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the constraint.

methods.name: enforced
methods.description: Indicates whether the constraint is enforced.

methods.name: validationStatus
methods.description: Returns the validation status of the constraint.

methods.name: rely
methods.description: Indicates whether the constraint relies on other constraints.

methods.name: toDDL
methods.description: Generates the Data Definition Language (DDL) string for the constraint.

methods.name: toDescription
methods.description: Provides a textual description of the constraint.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the DDL string representation of the constraint.

methods.name: toDDL (protected)
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated list of column references for DDL.
